### About

IT luggage is a well-known and respected brand of luggage, with over 35 years’ experience in the market. It has established itself as one of the leading international luggage brands, offering stylish and innovative designs that keep customers coming back time and time again.

It’s range of products includes hard shell and soft shell suitcases, laptop bags, handbags, travel accessories, and more, catering to a variety of tastes and budgets. It also produces a line of kid-focused luggage, making it accessible to the whole family.
